verdict.rationale: Steel documents Agent Traces, which turn a run into a timeline of agent activity alongside the session recording, with exports of markdown, JSON, or a ZIP with screenshots. Its overview also lists session replays and agent observability as product features. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of video replay playback, explicit failure/error-diagnosis workflow within traces, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an automation-engineer, I can debug a failed agent run from recorded replays — video, screenshots, step-by-step action timelines

citations.quote: It turns the run into a timeline of agent activity, so you can see what happened without scrubbing through the whole recording.
Copy the run as markdown, download JSON, or grab a ZIP with markdown plus screenshots.
